claim: The Recognition hint describes the meaning the card asks for, so I read the answer instead of recalling it.
evidence: Recognition FRONT: 'まで / marking how far along a route you are travelling'. Answer: 'To, as far as (particle)'.
fix: Shorten the Recognition cue to something that only picks the sense without defining it (for example 'with a place'), or keep the description on the Production face only.

claim: The Recognition hint is a paraphrase of the answer.
evidence: Recognition FRONT: 'を / marking a space that is moved along or through'. Answer: 'Particle marking a place or space passed through'.
fix: Use a cue that selects this を without defining it (for example 'with まがります or まっすぐいきます'), or show the hint on Production only.

claim: The Recognition hint says what で means here, so the front tests nothing.
evidence: Recognition FRONT: 'で / naming what something is sent by, or travelled by'. Answer: 'Particle marking a means of communication or transportation'.
fix: Replace the cue with one that only rules out the place-of-action で (for example 'with メール or バス'), or move it to the Production face.

claim: The Recognition hint contains the answer word 'taking'.
evidence: Recognition FRONT: 'とります / picking something up or taking it with you'. Answer: 'Take'.
fix: Cue it as 'not a photo' (which is all the front needs to separate it from Lesson 11's とります 'Take (a photo)'), or keep the description on Production only.

claim: The Recognition hint contains the answer word 'stop', and no other とめます I know needs to be told apart.
evidence: Recognition FRONT: 'とめます / telling a driver where to stop'. Answer: 'Stop'.
fix: Drop the hint from the Recognition face; keep it on Production if it is needed there.

claim: The Recognition hint contains the answer word 'writing'.
evidence: Recognition FRONT: 'かきます / writing your name or address on a form'. Answer: 'Write'.
fix: Use a cue that separates it from 'Draw' without naming the answer (for example 'with なまえ or じゅうしょ'), or drop it, since Lesson 17's かきます 'Write' card already carries this meaning.

claim: This card repeats Lesson 17's かきます 'Write' card with the same answer and the same English, so I study the same word twice as two separate cards.
evidence: chapter-19 kakimasu-l19: 'かきます | Write' (Production FRONT: 'Work & Occupations / Write / writing your name or address on a form'). chapter-17 kakimasu: 'かきます | Write'.
fix: Drop this card, or fold the 'on a form' use into a note on the Lesson 17 card.

claim: 'Just before' is close to Lesson 17's まえ 'Before', and nothing on the front says it is a place word, so I am likely to answer まえ.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Directions / Just before'. Answer: てまえ. Earlier cards: 'まえ | Before' (Lesson 17), 'まえ | In front' (Lesson 12), 'かいぎのまえに | Before the meeting'. The difference from まえ is only explained in the note on the back.
fix: Add a hint such as 'the near side of a landmark, not a time'.

claim: The note points at 'this chapter's third grammar point', a numbering from the book that a learner in Anki cannot see.
evidence: Note: 'Takes を (o) for the place you turn at, which is this chapter's third grammar point: つぎのしんごうをみぎにまがってください'.
fix: Drop the reference and just say 'を marks the place you turn at', or name the を card (marking a space moved along or through).

claim: The Production hint names the verb whose past form the card asks for, when 'Sent' alone already points to the only send verb I know.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Work & Occupations / Sent / Past of おくります'. Answer: おくりました. The only 'Send' card I have is 'おくります | Send' (Lesson 9).
fix: Drop the hint from the Production front, or move 'Past of おくります' to the back.

claim: The English says it asks someone to do something, but the note says it is used when asking for a noun, and the only example sentence asks for a thing.
evidence: Answer: 'May I ask [you to do this]?'. Note: 'More polite than おねがいします when asking for a noun.' Extras card moufu-o-onegai-dekimasu-ka: 'もうふをおねがいできますか | May I ask for a blanket?'.
fix: Make the gloss and the note agree, for example 'May I ask (for this / you to do this)?' with a note saying it works with a noun before を.

claim: 'Mail' with no cue is easy to answer with メール, which I learned as 'E-mail'.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Technology & Communication / Mail'. Answer: ゆうびん. Lesson 9: 'メール | E-mail', same category.
fix: Gloss it 'Mail (postal)' or add a hint 'by post, not e-mail'.

claim: 'Package' now has two targets: Lesson 18 taught パッケージ 'Package', and this chapter's sentences want にもつ for 'the package' with nothing to choose between them.
evidence: Base: 'にもつ | Package, luggage'; Lesson 18: 'パッケージ | Package' (no hint). Extras: 'Please deliver the package by 5:00 tomorrow.' = あしたのごじまでににもつをとどけてください; 'Please call before you deliver the package.' = にもつをとどけるまえに…; 'Please send this package to Chan-san…' = …このにもつをおくってください; but 'There were many interesting packages.' = おもしろいパッケージがたくさんありました.
fix: Gloss にもつ as 'parcel' or 'luggage' throughout (and the sentence cards to match), or add a note on both word cards saying パッケージ is packaging design and にもつ is a parcel you send or carry.

claim: 'Documents' is already one of the meanings I learned for しりょう, and this card has no hint or note telling the two apart.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Work & Occupations / Documents'. Answer: しょるい, no note. Lesson 17: 'しりょう | Material, data, documents'; Lesson 18 extras: 'かいぎのまえにしりょうをよみます… | I'll read the documents before the meeting…'.
fix: Add a note contrasting the two (しょるい are paperwork and forms, しりょう are reference materials) and a hint such as 'paperwork'.

claim: The English says 'documents', which this chapter teaches as しょるい, but the answer is しりょう.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Grammar & Function Words / Please bring the documents before the meeting.' Answer: かいぎのまえにしりょうをもってきてください. Base: 'しょるい | Documents'. Other extras cards use 'documents' for しょるい: 'Please deliver the documents to the president's office.' = しょるいを…, 'I'll send the documents by Friday.' = …しょるいをおくります.
fix: Gloss it 'Please bring the materials before the meeting.', as the chapter's other しりょう cards do ('I sent the material by e-mail yesterday…').

claim: The English says 'documents', which this chapter teaches as しょるい, but the answer is しりょう.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Work & Occupations / Excuse me. Please bring the documents for the meeting.' Answer: すみません。かいぎのしりょうをもってきてください. Base: 'しょるい | Documents'.
fix: Gloss it 'Excuse me. Please bring the materials for the meeting.'

claim: 'I'll get the documents' does not point me to とります, which I learned as 'Take', and 'documents' could be しりょう.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Grammar & Function Words / Please wait a moment. I'll get the documents.' Answer: ちょっとまってください。しょるいをとります. Base: 'とります | Take', 'もってきます | Bring'.
fix: Gloss it 'Please wait a moment. I'll take the documents.' or add a hint 'pick them up: とります'.

claim: The base card taught 'Yes, certainly.' as しょうちしました on its own, without はい, so on this front with the same English I will leave out はい.
evidence: This card: Production FRONT 'Travel & Tourism / Yes, certainly. / A hotel employee answers a guest's request for a blanket', Answer: はい、しょうちしました. Base shouchi-shimashita: 'Yes, certainly. / formal, to a boss or a customer; the expression on its own, without はい (hai)', Answer: しょうちしました.
fix: Add a hint 'with はい' to this card, or gloss the base card without 'Yes'.

claim: いまから plus a place plus ですか to mean 'are you headed there now' is a construction no card taught, and the card has no note.
evidence: Card: 'いまからおおさかししゃですか | Are you now headed to the Osaka branch office?', no note. I know 'いま | Now', 'から | From (particle)' and 'から | Because, so', and every place-plus-です sentence I know says where something is ('レストランは５かいです'). Read literally it is 'From now, Osaka branch?', and nothing tells me です stands in for 'going'.
fix: Add a note: 'いまから means "from now"; X ですか here asks whether X is where the person is going, with です standing in for いきます.'

claim: 'Tell your colleagues' fits three verbs I know, and I would answer おしえる, which I learned as 'Tell'.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Grammar & Function Words / Please call me before you tell your colleagues.' Answer: どうりょうにいうまえに、わたしにでんわをしてください. Earlier: 'おしえます | Tell, teach', 'おしえる | Tell, teach (dictionary form)'; this chapter: 'いいます | Say', 'つたえます | Relay a message'.
fix: Gloss it 'before you say it to your colleagues', or add a hint 'say: いう'.

claim: 'Before we take your luggage' points me to とる, which this chapter teaches as 'Take', not to あずかる 'Keep, take care of'.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Grammar & Function Words / Please write your name before we take your luggage.' Answer: にもつをあずかるまえに、なまえをかいてください. Base: 'とります | Take', 'あずかります | Keep, take care of'; Lesson 15: 'とる | Take (dictionary form)'. The sister card azukarimasu-front uses 'keeps'.
fix: Gloss it 'before we look after your luggage' or 'before we keep your luggage'.

claim: The English says 'my bag', which I learned as かばん, and adds 'p.m.', which the target does not have.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Travel & Tourism / Please keep my bag here until 5:00 p.m. / Checking out of a hotel, you ask the front desk to hold your luggage during the day'. Answer: にもつを5じまであずかってください. Lesson 2: 'かばん | Bag'; Lesson 3: 'ごご | P.M., in the afternoon'.
fix: Gloss it 'Please keep my luggage until 5:00.' to match the target and the scene.

claim: The note says this を means 'through' the intersection, 'not at it', but the chapter's turn cards translate the same を as 'at'.
evidence: Note: 'The を (o) marks the space you pass through, so つぎのこうさてんを (tsugi no kōsaten o) means "through the next intersection", not "at" it.' Against that: 'つぎのしんごうをひだりにまがってください | Please turn left at the next traffic light.', 'ふたつめのかどをみぎにまがってください | Please turn right at the second corner.'
fix: Reword the note so it does not deny 'at', for example 'with まっすぐいきます, the を place is the one you go straight through; with まがります it is the one you turn at'.

claim: Eight notes say まえに 'always follows the dictionary form', which the deck's own cards contradict: a noun takes の before まえに.
evidence: Notes on kuruma-wo-tomeru-mae-ni-denwa ('the form まえに (before) always follows'), douryou-ni-iu-mae-ni-denwa, shingou-wo-magaru-mae-ni-tomete, nimotsu-wo-todokeru-mae-ni-denwa, shorui-wo-motte-kuru-mae-ni-yonde, shachou-ni-tsutaeru-mae-ni-oshiete, shachou-ni-houkoku-suru-mae-ni-repooto and nimotsu-wo-azukaru-mae-ni-namae: 'まえに (mae ni, "before") always follows the dictionary form, as in ねるまえに from Lesson 17.' Against that, this unit's own motte-kite-meeting: 'かいぎのまえにしりょうをもってきてください', and Lesson 17's 'かいぎのまえに | Before the meeting'.
fix: Change 'always follows the dictionary form' to 'a verb before まえに is in its dictionary form' in all eight notes.
